{"notes": "Visit 1 (left at 1:45). I don't know who placed which domino, so nothing below is credited to anyone by guess.

State of the build: a fish body with top and belly lines running from the start, and every domino in them connected. One pale, unconnected domino sits near the tail tip at about (23.5, 8.3). The tail is still the old notched version, and the two tail lines end apart without joining. The team plans to redraw it as a rounded tail.

Sofia: Never heard her speak. Hana says she was busy laying the body, which I can't confirm. The body she may have built is connected and clean. She handed over the planning pad, or was asked to. Need more evidence on her collaboration and communication.

Omar: Neither seen nor heard doing anything this visit. No evidence either way, so no rating yet. Check on him next visit, ask him privately what he's working on, and don't assume he's idle.

Hana: Took the lead on the tail redesign. Gave clear instructions (wide rounded sweep, no notch, gentle joins) and split the work (Jack the lower tail, her the top). Strong leadership and direction so far. Watch that she keeps others involved and builds as well as plans. At 1:30 she asked for the pad directly, which is a little pushy but reasonable. I haven't seen her place a domino.

Jack: Checked connectivity and reported the body had no breaks, which the picture backs up. Supported Hana's plan and offered to patch gaps or take the lower tail. Good collaboration and QA. Not yet seen building. Check he actually follows through on the lower tail and the stray pale domino.

Next visit: see whether the tail gets finished and joined, whether the stray domino is fixed, and what Omar is doing."}
